name: Helping Hand
body:
Part of your study included using magic to make simple tasks easier.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: mage hand, open/close, and floating disk. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level.
